lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: The Outwall. Where the coin|is earned, and never spent.
lines.text: The Outwall. Where the coin is earned, and never spent.

lines.speaker: brannet
lines.subtitle: You're the ice-king? We've had kings before.|They stand on the wall and watch.
lines.text: You're the ice-king? We've had kings before. They stand on the wall and watch.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Then I will stand down here. Ring your bells|when I tell you, and bring your people to me.
lines.text: Then I will stand down here. Ring your bells when I tell you, and bring your people to me.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: The Glass Hall is open, my lord.|It holds more than you think. Winter is roomy.
lines.text: The Glass Hall is open, my lord. It holds more than you think. Winter is roomy.

lines.speaker: brannet
lines.subtitle: Rope Row's coming. Mind the old ones,|they walk slow. Like you, no offence.
lines.text: Rope Row's coming. Mind the old ones, they walk slow. Like you, no offence.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Crimson lanterns on the water.|Aurivane burns what it cannot buy.
lines.text: Crimson lanterns on the water. Aurivane burns what it cannot buy.

lines.speaker: brannet
lines.subtitle: Facetguards, turned back by an ice-king. I'll|be telling that one in the tavern for years.
lines.text: Facetguards, turned back by an ice-king. I'll be telling that one in the tavern for years.

lines.speaker: brannet
lines.subtitle: The Archon's press took a whole lane. They'll|dig till they drop, and nobody'll count them.
lines.text: The Archon's press took a whole lane. They'll dig till they drop, and nobody'll count them.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Men in grey masks, out of the old adit.|They do not take coin. They take people.
lines.text: Men in grey masks, out of the old adit. They do not take coin. They take people.

lines.speaker: diamond_archon
lines.subtitle: Ice-king. Adamarch did not open its|harbour to you so you could herd fishermen.
lines.text: Ice-king. Adamarch did not open its harbour to you so you could herd fishermen.

lines.speaker: diamond_archon
lines.subtitle: Guard my pits. The diamonds pay for your|dragons. The Outwall can look after itself.
lines.text: Guard my pits. The diamonds pay for your dragons. The Outwall can look after itself.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: It has been looking after itself for a thousand|years, Your Radiance. Look where it got them.
lines.text: It has been looking after itself for a thousand years, Your Radiance. Look where it got them.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Diamond tithe. Every minute you stand there,|my lord, the Archon pays. Every minute.
lines.text: Diamond tithe. Every minute you stand there, my lord, the Archon pays. Every minute.

lines.speaker: diamond_archon
lines.subtitle: Those beasts are the property of the|Diamond Hall. You will answer for them.
lines.text: Those beasts are the property of the Diamond Hall. You will answer for them.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Then I will answer for them.|They will answer to nobody.
lines.text: Then I will answer for them. They will answer to nobody.

lines.speaker: brannet
lines.subtitle: Net Lane, out! Follow the cold, it's the|only thing tonight that isn't lying to us.
lines.text: Net Lane, out! Follow the cold, it's the only thing tonight that isn't lying to us.

lines.speaker: brannet
lines.subtitle: The boats are in. Two crews, sixteen souls,|and the whole night coming for them.
lines.text: The boats are in. Two crews, sixteen souls, and the whole night coming for them.

lines.speaker: seraphine
lines.subtitle: The Archon forbade this. The Hall of Silence|can fine me. These are Adamarch's people too.
lines.text: The Archon forbade this. The Hall of Silence can fine me. These are Adamarch's people too.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Pits to the east, fishers to the south.|Aldra, I cannot stand in two places.
lines.text: Pits to the east, fishers to the south. Aldra, I cannot stand in two places.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Their captain comes himself. Break his mask,|my lord. I want to see what is under it.
lines.text: Their captain comes himself. Break his mask, my lord. I want to see what is under it.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Violet. And a candle sigil. Malrik,|you are taking rowers from the gutter now.
lines.text: Violet. And a candle sigil. Malrik, you are taking rowers from the gutter now.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: His gift at the auction was their wages.|Tonight he came back for the men.
lines.text: His gift at the auction was their wages. Tonight he came back for the men.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: The last tide, Ice-king. The cities always|send the biggest boats just before morning.
lines.text: The last tide, Ice-king. The cities always send the biggest boats just before morning.

lines.speaker: brannet
lines.subtitle: Half the Outwall gone! Ice-king,|whatever you're guarding, it isn't us!
lines.text: Half the Outwall gone! Ice-king, whatever you're guarding, it isn't us!

lines.speaker: brannet
lines.subtitle: Every bell's rung. I never heard all|five at once. Sounds like a festival.
lines.text: Every bell's rung. I never heard all five at once. Sounds like a festival.

lines.speaker: brannet
lines.subtitle: Dawn, and the Outwall's still here. Nobody on|the wall will ever thank you. So: thank you.
lines.text: Dawn, and the Outwall's still here. Nobody on the wall will ever thank you. So: thank you.

lines.speaker: diamond_archon
lines.subtitle: The pits held. Adamarch pays its debts,|Ice-king. It never forgets them, either.
lines.text: The pits held. Adamarch pays its debts, Ice-king. It never forgets them, either.

lines.speaker: diamond_archon
lines.subtitle: My pits stood empty all night.|Remember that I asked you, and that you chose.
lines.text: My pits stood empty all night. Remember that I asked you, and that you chose.

lines.speaker: ossavar
lines.subtitle: You did not pay for that, Ice-king.|Nobody paid for that. I will remember.
lines.text: You did not pay for that, Ice-king. Nobody paid for that. I will remember.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: I waited too long again. The lanes|are quiet. Too quiet, for a morning.
lines.text: I waited too long again. The lanes are quiet. Too quiet, for a morning.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Not here... not in front of them...
lines.text: Not here... not in front of them...

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: The lanes are empty, my lord.|There is nobody left to shelter.
lines.text: The lanes are empty, my lord. There is nobody left to shelter.
